## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.RadarChart(
    value=[
        {"name": "A", "color": "", "values": [4, 3, 5, 2, 4]},
        {"name": "B", "color": "", "values": [2, 5, 3, 4, 3]},
    ],
    label="RadarChart",
    axes=["speed", "power", "cost", "mass", "range"],
    size=(220, 220),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | array of object | `[]` | host | Data sets {name, color, values}. |
| `axes` | array of string | `[]` | host | Axis names; empty: axes numbered from the longest data set. |
| `ranges` | array of array | `[]` | host | [min, max] per axis, max > min; an axis without a valid range goes from 0 to the largest value of the data sets. |
| `fill` | boolean | `true` | host | Fill the data set polygons. |
